# Vendored code

`d3-map.js` bundles only the D3 modules the map uses (d3-selection 3.0.0, d3-zoom 3.0.0, d3-force 3.0.0,
d3-hierarchy 3.1.2, d3-shape 3.2.0, d3-transition 3.0.1 and their dependencies), built with esbuild as an ES module.
